scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @sahi/shared && npm run build -w @sahi/db
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @sahi/web && npm run build -w @sahi/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
